Built-in playground for testing models without leaving the pearl.

apps.name: BotMother
apps.shortDescription: Telegram bot manager with message routing and chatrooms
apps.description:
# BotMother

**Your Telegram bot. Your server. Your routing rules.**

BotMother is a Telegram bot manager with message routing and chatroom support, running on Melusina. Each bot configuration lives in its own **Pearl** — a sealed, per-document container with its own database, message history, and permissions. No bot Pearl can see another unless you explicitly connect them via **Grapple**.

---

## 🤖 How It Works

Create a new Pearl to configure a Telegram bot. Register your bot token from BotFather, define routing rules, and BotMother handles the rest. Messages flow through your server — never through a third party.

### Key Features

- **Per-Pearl Isolation** — Each bot runs in its own sealed container with separate storage, config, and message logs
- **Message Routing** — Define rules to route incoming messages by command, keyword, or sender
- **Chatroom Support** — Manage group conversations and route messages between channels
- **Grapple Connections** — Link BotMother Pearls to other app Pearls — trigger actions in Bureau spreadsheets, pipe notifications into Instasys Mail, or log events to MiniGit
- **Webhook Integration** — Receive and process Telegram webhook events in real-time
- **Privacy-First** — All messages stay on your server. No third-party bot hosting. No message logging by others
- **Offline Queuing** — Messages received while offline are queued and processed when the bot reconnects

---

## 🔧 Setup

1. Create a bot via [BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) on Telegram
2. Copy the bot token
3. Create a new BotMother Pearl and paste the token
4. Define your routing rules
5. Your bot is live — routing messages through your own server

---

## 🔐 Security Model

| Role | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| 👁️ **Viewer** | See bot status and message logs |
| ✏️ **Editor** | Configure routing rules, manage chatrooms |
| 👑 **Admin** | Manage bot tokens, permissions, and Grapple connections |

> Every message, every routing rule, every bot token stays inside the Pearl. Server-side permission enforcement — no client-side trust.

---

## 💰 Pricing

**Free.** Install and use on your own server. No subscription, no per-message fees, no limits.

apps.name: CyberTeller
apps.description:
# CyberTeller

Crypto invoicing and payment processor.

## Features

- **Invoice API** – create invoices via REST (`POST /api/invoices`) with amount, currency, description, and customer details
- **Unique payment addresses** – each invoice gets a fresh HD-wallet derived address per chain (no address reuse)
- **4 supported blockchains** – Ethereum, Tron, Solana, TON
- **Crypto & stablecoins** – ETH, TRX, SOL, TON native coins + USDT / USDC on every supported chain
- **Payment page** – customer-facing page with QR codes and copy-address buttons, auto-refreshes via HTMX every 15 s
- **Payment status tracking** – `paid` / `underpaid` / `overpaid` / `expired`
- **Webhook endpoint** – `POST /api/payment/notify` for blockchain monitoring integrations
- **Admin panel** – dashboard, invoice detail view, live YAML config editor
- **YAML config** – editable at runtime via admin UI (chains, tokens, expiry, tolerance thresholds, wallet seed)

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Backend | Go 1.24, `net/http` + chi router |
| Frontend | HTMX, vanilla JS |
| Database | SQLite (CGO-free via modernc.org/sqlite) |
| HD wallet | BIP-39/BIP-32 (secp256k1) · SLIP-0010 (ed25519) |
| QR codes | github.com/skip2/go-qrcode |

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Clone and install dependencies
git clone https://github.com/hrbrlife/cyberteller
cd cyberteller
go mod download

# 2. Edit config.yaml – set your wallet mnemonic and admin password hash
#    Generate a bcrypt hash:  htpasswd -bnBC 10 "" yourpassword | tr -d ':\n'

# 3. Run
go run .
# Server starts on http://0.0.0.0:8080
```

Environment variables (all optional):

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `CONFIG_PATH` | `config.yaml` | Path to config file |
| `DB_PATH` | `cyberteller.db` | Path to SQLite database |
| `BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` | Public URL used in payment links |

## API

### Create Invoice

```http
POST /api/invoices
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amount": "99.99",
  "currency": "USD",
  "description": "Order #42",
  "customer_name": "Alice",
  "customer_email": "alice@example.com"
}
```

Response `201 Created`:
```json
{
  "id": "...",
  "payment_link": "http://localhost:8080/pay/abc12345",
  "expires_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00Z",
  "status": "pending"
}
```

### Payment Webhook

Called by your blockchain monitoring service when a payment is detected:

```http
POST /api/payment/notify
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

invoice_id=...&chain=ethereum&token=USDT&address=0x...&tx_hash=0x...&amount=99.99
```

## Admin Panel

Navigate to `http://localhost:8080/admin` (HTTP Basic Auth).

Default credentials: `admin` / `changeme` — **change before production** by updating `password_hash` in `config.yaml`.

## Security Notes

- Replace the default wallet mnemonic in `config.yaml` with your own before using with real funds
- The mnemonic in `config.yaml` is used to derive all payment addresses — back it up securely
- Change the admin password hash before deploying
- The payment notification endpoint (`/api/payment/notify`) should be firewall-restricted to your blockchain monitoring service in production

![Payment page screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/29088b6d-ac48-401a-b899-14c326fe18d0)

apps.description:
# Bureau

**Your office suite. Your rules.**

Four Pearl types — Spreadsheet, Document, Diagram, miniPaint — replacing Google Docs, Sheets, and cloud image editors for teams that refuse to hand their work to someone else's infrastructure.

Live collaboration. End-to-end encryption (coming soon).

Don't share your entire office each time you need an external tool (that's if you even need one given that you're using Melusina and can run anything locally) — share document by document!

---

## Why Bureau

| | Google / Microsoft | Bureau on Melusina |
|---|---|---|
| 🏠 **Where your data lives** | Their servers, their jurisdiction | Your server, your jurisdiction |
| 🔒 **Who can see it** | The vendor, their partners, hackers who breach them | Only people you explicitly share with |
| 🧱 **Isolation** | One breach exposes everything | Each Pearl is a sealed container — a breach in one stays in one |
| 🔗 **Connections** | Everything wired to everything behind the scenes | Nothing connects unless you choose via Grapple |
| 🤖 **AI** | Your data trains their models | AI reads only what you grant, writes only what you approve |
| 📡 **Offline** | Needs internet | Works air-gapped — every asset bundled |
| 💸 **Lock-in** | Try exporting from Google — it's a project | XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML — leave anytime |
| 👁️ **Tracking** | Analytics, telemetry, ad targeting | Zero. No phone-home. No CDNs. No tracking pixels |

---

## Four Pearls. Four Workspaces. Zero Overlap.

### 📊 Spreadsheet

The spreadsheet your accountant can actually trust.

Multiple users edit the same sheet at the same time — every keystroke arrives in real time. Not "syncs eventually." Real time. Formulas, formatting, multiple worksheets, comments, merge cells, sorting, search, pagination — the full toolkit. Import your existing Excel files with styles and column widths intact. Export to XLSX, CSV, PDF, or JSON when you need to share outside Melusina.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| Collaboration | Simultaneous multi-user editing, live presence indicators |
| Formatting | Fonts, colors, bold, italic, borders, alignment, fill, text wrap |
| Formulas | A1 references, formula bar, cross-cell calculations |
| Worksheets | Multiple tabs — rename, reorder, add, delete |
| Structure | Merge cells, freeze rows/columns, hide columns, multi-level sort |
| Comments | Per-cell threads with author attribution |
| Import | XLSX (preserves styles), CSV, JSON |
| Export | XLSX, CSV, ZIP (all sheets), PDF (per-sheet, ranges, page sizes), JSON |
| AI Agent | Connect to AI Lagoon — AI reads/writes cells through capability-scoped tools with human-in-the-loop confirmation |
| Snapshots | Named versions — save, browse, compare, restore |
| Mobile | Responsive layout, touch support, collapsible toolbar |
| Themes | Light and Dark with keyboard toggle |

### 📝 Document

Write together without conflicts — mathematically guaranteed.

Bureau Documents use Yjs CRDT — a technology where simultaneous edits merge automatically without conflicts. Two people editing the same paragraph at the same time? Both edits survive. No "someone else is editing this" lockouts. No copy-of-copy-of-final-v2 chaos.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| Collaboration | Conflict-free CRDT sync — unlimited simultaneous editors |
| Formatting | Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough |
| Structure | Headings (H1–H3), bullet lists, numbered lists, blockquotes, code blocks, horizontal rules |
| Tables | Insert and edit tables inline |
| Sections | Organize long documents into named sections |
| Snapshots | Named versions with one-click restore |
| Export | HTML |

### 📐 Diagram

Flowcharts, org charts, and architecture diagrams — with the full draw.io engine.

Not a simplified diagramming toy. The complete draw.io application, running inside your Melusina Pearl. Every stencil library. Every shape. Every connector. Flowcharts, UML, ER diagrams, BPMN, network topology, freeform drawing. One person edits at a time — everyone else sees changes appear live.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| Engine | Full draw.io (mxGraph) — the same tool used by millions |
| Diagram types | Flowcharts, org charts, UML, ER, BPMN, network, freeform |
| Shape library | Complete draw.io stencil collection |
| Collaboration | Live viewer updates — edit lock with auto-acquire and auto-release |
| Export | XML, PNG, SVG, PDF |
| Snapshots | Named versions with restore |
| Offline | All draw.io assets bundled — no internet needed |

### 🎨 miniPaint

Quick image editing without uploading your photos to someone else's server.

Layers, filters, drawing tools, crop, resize, rotate — the essentials you need for graphics work without installing desktop software or trusting a cloud image editor with your files. Save snapshots before destructive edits. Export in any format you need.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| Layers | Create, reorder, merge, manage |
| Drawing | Pencil, brush, line, circle, rectangle, text |
| Filters | Blur, sharpen, brightness, contrast, adjustments |
| Transform | Crop, resize, rotate |
| Export | PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP |
| Snapshots | Named versions with restore |
| Collaboration | Lock-based editing — one editor, live viewers |

---

## AI Agent Integration

Bureau is a first-class MCP (Model Context Protocol) host. Connect your AI — it works for you, not the other way around.

### How It Works

1. **Grant access via Grapple.** Click "Connect via Grapple" in the AI Assistant panel. Melusina's Grapple dialog appears — pick the AI Lagoon Pearl you want to connect. That's the only permission step.

2. **AI reads your data through capability-scoped tools.** The AI can call `get_headers`, `get_rows`, and `get_cell` — nothing more. It can't access other Pearls, other data, or the filesystem. The scope is locked to exactly what you granted.

3. **Human-in-the-loop for writes.** When the AI wants to modify your spreadsheet (`set_cell`, `add_row`, `add_column`), Bureau pauses and asks you: *"The agent wants to write changes — Approve or Deny?"* Every write requires your explicit confirmation.

4. **Full audit trail.** Every tool call is logged with the tool name, parameters, result, duration, and which iteration of the AI's reasoning triggered it. You can inspect exactly what the AI did and why.

5. **Persistent connection.** Once granted, the AI Lagoon connection survives Pearl restarts — no need to re-grant via Grapple each time. Disconnect anytime with one click.

### What This Means

| Traditional AI Integration | Bureau + AI Lagoon |
|---|---|
| AI accesses everything in your account | AI sees only the Pearl you connected — nothing else |
| AI writes silently to your documents | Every write requires your approval |
| AI vendor sees your data | AI runs on your server — data never leaves |
| You can't see what the AI did | Full tool call audit trail in the panel |
| Connection is permanent and invisible | You grant and revoke access explicitly via Grapple |

### Technical Details

- **Protocol:** MCP over native Cap'n Proto — no HTTP proxying, no JSON overhead, direct capability passing across Pearl boundaries
- **Architecture:** Bureau acts as an MCP Host, exposing a `ContextProvider` capability. AI Lagoon acts as the `AIAgent`. Bureau passes its ContextProvider into each agent request — the AI calls back to read/write data through the same capability channel
- **Security model:** Object-capability (OCAP). No ambient authority. The AI agent has exactly one capability — the ContextProvider you gave it. It cannot escalate, enumerate other Pearls, or access the network
- **Templates:** Pre-built agent templates (Structured Data Agent, Document Drafter, Process Automation, General Assistant) guide the AI toward common tasks without custom prompting

---

## What Makes Bureau Different

### 🧱 Every Pearl Is a Sealed Room

A spreadsheet can't see a document. A diagram can't read an image. They're not permission-separated — they're physically isolated containers. A vulnerability in one Pearl cannot reach another. This is Melusina's core architecture, and Bureau inherits it completely.

### 📸 Snapshots Everywhere

Every Pearl type supports named version snapshots. Before a big edit, save a snapshot. Made a mistake last Tuesday? Restore it. Need to compare this quarter's numbers with last quarter's? Browse your history. One click to save. One click to restore.

### 👥 Real-Time Collaboration

See who's connected. See their role. Watch edits appear as they happen. Presence indicators show names and avatars. Connection status tells you when you're online, reconnecting, or offline. When you reconnect, everything syncs automatically.

### 🔐 Four Roles. Server-Enforced.

Not client-side hints — actual server-enforced permission boundaries.

| Role | View | Comment | Edit | Admin |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 👁️ Viewer | ✓ | — | — | — |
| 💬 Commenter | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| ✏️ Editor | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — |
| 🔑 Admin | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

Viewers can't modify data. Period. Not "the button is hidden" — the server rejects the request. Import restrictions are role-gated: CSV import is admin-only, XLSX requires editor.

### 🔗 Grapple: Connect Only What You Choose

Need a diagram to reference a spreadsheet? Need an AI to analyze your data? Use Grapple — Melusina's capability system. You pick exactly which two Pearls connect and what capability they exchange. One link. Nothing else changes. Revoke anytime.

### ✈️ Fully Air-Gapped

Every font, every icon, every JavaScript library, every stylesheet — bundled inside the package. Bureau works on a Melusina instance with zero internet access. No CDNs. No external requests. Nothing phones home.

---

## Getting Started

**Create a Pearl** — Click New, choose Bureau, pick your Pearl type. You're working in seconds.

**Share it** — Hit Share, pick a role (Viewer, Commenter, Editor, Admin), send the link. Recipients join instantly with live collaboration.

**Connect an AI** — Open the AI Assistant panel (🤖), click "Connect via Grapple," choose your AI Lagoon Pearl. Ask questions about your data in natural language.

**Save a Snapshot** — Tap the camera icon, name your version, save. Your history is always one click away.

**Import your files** — Drag in XLSX, CSV, or JSON. Styles, column widths, and formatting come with it.

**Export anything** — XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML. Standard formats. No lock-in. Leave whenever you want.

---

## Capabilities

| | Spreadsheet | Document | Diagram | miniPaint |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Real-time multi-user editing | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| Live viewer updates | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| AI Agent (MCP) | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Named snapshots | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Role-based permissions | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| XLSX import/export | ✓ | — | — | — |
| PDF export | ✓ | — | ✓ | — |
| CSV export | ✓ | — | — | — |
| HTML export | — | ✓ | — | — |
| SVG export | — | — | ✓ | — |
| PNG/JPG export | — | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Formulas | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Rich text formatting | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| Drawing tools | — | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Layers | — | — | — | ✓ |
| Multiple worksheets/sections | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| Comments | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Light/Dark themes | ✓ | — | — | — |
| Mobile-responsive | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Works fully offline | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

---

## Limitations

Bureau is honest about what it doesn't do yet.

| Limitation | Explanation |
|---|---|
| AI Agent for Spreadsheet and Document | Diagram and miniPaint ContextProviders are planned. |
| No simultaneous editing in Diagram/miniPaint | One editor at a time. Everyone else sees live updates. |
| No cursor tracking in Spreadsheet | Cell values update live, but you don't see other users' cursors. |
| No presentation/slideshow Pearl | Not yet. |
| No cross-Pearl formulas | Each spreadsheet is independent. Use Grapple to link Pearls at the app level. |
| No offline editing without server | Data lives server-side. You need a connection to your Melusina instance. |

---

## FAQ

**How is this different from Google Sheets?**
Google Sheets runs on Google's servers. Google can read your data, train AI on it, change terms, raise prices, or get subpoenaed. Bureau runs on your Melusina instance. Your hardware. Your jurisdiction. No one else can see it.

**What about AI — doesn't it send my data to the cloud?**
No. AI Lagoon runs on your Melusina instance alongside Bureau. Your data travels from one Pearl to another on the same machine over a capability channel. Nothing leaves your server. The AI model itself runs locally or connects to a provider you choose and control.

**Can I import my Excel files?**
Yes. XLSX import preserves styles, column widths, and formatting. You can also import CSV and JSON.

**How many people can edit at once?**
Spreadsheet and Document support unlimited simultaneous editors. Diagram and miniPaint use edit locking — one editor at a time, but all connected users see changes live.

**What if I lose connection?**
The status indicator shows your connection state. When you reconnect, the client re-syncs automatically. Document Pearls use CRDT — even concurrent offline edits merge without conflicts.

**Can I leave Melusina and take my data?**
Yes. Export everything in standard formats: XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML. No lock-in. No exit fees.

**Does it need internet after installation?**
No. Every asset is bundled. Bureau works on fully air-gapped Melusina instances.

**Can one Pearl access another Pearl's data?**
Only if you explicitly connect them via Grapple. By default, every Pearl is completely isolated — not permission-separated, physically separated. When you do connect (e.g., Bureau ↔ AI Lagoon), each side exchanges a single capability. The AI can read your spreadsheet headers and rows — it cannot browse your filesystem, access other Pearls, or escalate privileges.

---

*Bureau is part of the Melusina app library. Self-hosted. Sovereign. Open source.*

apps.description:
# OpenClaw

A personal AI assistant grain for Melusina.

OpenClaw is one **Sandstorm pearl**, two processes:

- a **Go capability sidecar** (`openclaw-bridge`) that owns the grain's
  Cap'n Proto control socket, handles Powerbox grants, and exposes a
  loopback HTTP API to the runtime;
- a **Node.js runtime** (the OpenClaw agent) that serves the chat UI,
  runs the inference loop through your AiLagoon grain, and discovers
  tools from any other Melusina grain you connect over Powerbox.

The two processes are bundled in a single SPK and started together by
`launcher.sh`. There is no `bridgeConfig` — permissions and roles are
defined programmatically in the bridge's `GetViewInfo()`, the same way
AiLagoon, AITX, and BLOOM_FINAL do it.

## Setup

1. Install the SPK on your Melusina instance.
2. Open the **New OpenClaw assistant** action.
3. Use Powerbox to grant the new grain access to an **AiLagoon** pearl
   so the agent can think.
4. Use Powerbox to connect any other Melusina grains you want OpenClaw
   to read or act on (Bureau spreadsheets and documents, AITX
   Procedures stations, Mermail mailboxes, Vintage desktops, anything
   that implements the `GrainContext` Cap'n Proto interface).
5. Chat with the assistant to configure monitors, schedules, and
   behaviour. Configuration is conversational and incremental — there
   is no global YAML to author.

## Features

- **Native Melusina pearl** — raw Cap'n Proto, programmatic ViewInfo,
  Powerbox-driven capability discovery, persistent state in `/var`.
- **AiLagoon-routed inference** — every LLM call goes through your own
  AiLagoon grain. OpenClaw never holds API keys directly.
- **Per-grain permission scoping** — each connected grain decides what
  the agent can see and do, based on the scope of the Powerbox grant.
  OpenClaw never interprets app permission tables itself.
- **Wallet-signed critical actions** — operations marked
  `walletSignature` or `threshold` in a grain's `describe()` must be
  approved by the user's connected Solana wallet via the Melusina
  shell's `requestChainSign()` flow.
- **Two grain types** — `assistant` (full runtime) and `dev-bridge`
  (sidecar with the demo grain registered, for testing).

See `MELUSINA_OPENCLAW_INTEGRATION_FINAL.md` in the OpenClaw repository
for the full architecture document and `capnp/graincontext.capnp` for
the universal Cap'n Proto interface every Melusina app implements to
become legible to OpenClaw.

MerMail is a sovereign email client for [Melusina](https://melusina-os.org), built with Go and HTMX. It connects directly to Melusina's Cap'n Proto APIs — no HTTP bridge required.

## Features

- **Inbox & Folders** — View, organise, and search your email across custom folders
- **Compose & Reply** — Rich compose form with reply, reply-all, and forward support
- **Attachments** — Upload, download, and inline-view attachments
- **Drafts** — Auto-save and manually save drafts; resume editing anytime
- **Search** — Full-text search across all messages
- **Star & Organise** — Star important messages, move between folders, bulk delete
- **Real-time Updates** — WebSocket push for new mail notifications
- **Role-based Access** — Melusina sharing with viewer, editor, and admin roles
- **Lightweight** — Single static binary, SQLite storage, zero external dependencies

## Pearl Types

MerMail ships two Pearl types:

- **Mailbox Pearl** — Your personal email client. Each Pearl is an independent mailbox with its own inbox, folders, drafts, and contacts.
- **Station Pearl** — Mail server control panel for managing forwarding rules, DNS configuration, and aliases.

## How It Works

Each Melusina Pearl is an independent mailbox. Email arrives via Melusina's built-in SMTP gateway and is stored locally in SQLite. The UI is server-rendered HTML with HTMX for seamless partial updates — no JavaScript framework required.

## Getting Started

1. Open the App Bazaar and install MerMail
2. Create a new **Mailbox** Pearl to start using email
3. Your Pearl gets a unique email address — forward mail to it or share it directly
4. Create a **Station** Pearl to manage mail server settings

## Technical Details

- **Backend:** Go with native Cap'n Proto RPC (no sandstorm-http-bridge)
- **Frontend:** Server-side HTML + HTMX + WebSocket
- **Storage:** SQLite with automatic migrations
- **Binary:** Statically linked, runs inside the Melusina Pearl sandbox

MiniGit provides lightweight, private Git hosting inside a Melusina pearl.

Each pearl is a standalone Git repository with a built-in web interface
powered by [Gogs](https://gogs.io). Clone, push, browse commits, diffs,
and manage branches — all from your browser.

**Features**

- Create a repository pearl in one click
- Push and pull over HTTPS (clone URL provided automatically)
- Browse files, commits, and diffs in the Gogs web UI
- Share read-only or read/write access via standard Melusina sharing
- SQLite-backed — zero external dependencies
- Fully offline-capable, no CDN or external calls

**Architecture**

MiniGit uses a native Cap'n Proto UiView implementation (no HTTP bridge).
A thin Go wrapper translates Melusina WebSession RPCs directly to
Gogs HTTP requests, giving fast, clean integration with the platform.

|---|---|---|

| 📡 **Offline** | Needs internet | Works air-gapped — every asset bundled |
| 💸 **Lock-in** | Try exporting from Google — it's a project | XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML — leave anytime |
| 👁️ **Tracking** | Analytics, telemetry, ad targeting | Zero. No phone-home. No CDNs. No tracking pixels |

Multiple users edit the same sheet at the same time — every keystroke arrives in real time. Not "syncs eventually." Real time. | Capability | Details |
|---|---|

| Comments | Per-cell threads with author attribution |

| Mobile | Responsive layout, touch support, collapsible toolbar |

### 📝 Document

Write together without conflicts — mathematically guaranteed.

Bureau Documents use Yjs CRDT — a technology where simultaneous edits merge automatically without conflicts. Two people editing the same paragraph at the same time? Both edits survive. No "someone else is editing this" lockouts. No copy-of-copy-of-final-v2 chaos.

|---|---|

| Formatting | Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough |
| Structure | Headings (H1–H3), bullet lists, numbered lists, blockquotes, code blocks, horizontal rules |
| Tables | Insert and edit tables inline |
| Sections | Organize long documents into named sections |
| Snapshots | Named versions with one-click restore |
| Export | HTML |

Flowcharts, org charts, and architecture diagrams — with the full draw.io engine.

Not a simplified diagramming toy. The complete draw.io application, running inside your Melusina Pearl. Every stencil library. Every shape. Every connector. Flowcharts, UML, ER diagrams, BPMN, network topology, freeform drawing. One person edits at a time — everyone else sees changes appear live.

| Transform | Crop, resize, rotate |
| Export | PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP |
| Snapshots | Named versions with restore |
| Collaboration | Lock-based editing — one editor, live viewers |

## AI Agent Integration

Bureau is a first-class MCP (Model Context Protocol) host. Connect your AI — it works for you, not the other way around.

### How It Works

1. **Grant access via Grapple.** Click "Connect via Grapple" in the AI Assistant panel. Melusina's Grapple dialog appears — pick the AI Lagoon Pearl you want to connect. That's the only permission step.

2. **AI reads your data through capability-scoped tools.** The AI can call `get_headers`, `get_rows`, and `get_cell` — nothing more. It can't access other Pearls, other data, or the filesystem. The scope is locked to exactly what you granted.

3. **Human-in-the-loop for writes.** When the AI wants to modify your spreadsheet (`set_cell`, `add_row`, `add_column`), Bureau pauses and asks you: *"The agent wants to write changes — Approve or Deny?"* Every write requires your explicit confirmation.

| Traditional AI Integration | Bureau + AI Lagoon |
|---|---|

- **Security model:** Object-capability (OCAP). No ambient authority. The AI agent has exactly one capability — the ContextProvider you gave it. It cannot escalate, enumerate other Pearls, or access the network

## AI Agent Integration

Bureau is a first-class MCP (Model Context Protocol) host. Connect your AI — it works for you, not the other way around.

### How It Works

1. **Grant access via Grapple.** Click "Connect via Grapple" in the AI Assistant panel. Melusina's Grapple dialog appears — pick the AI Lagoon Pearl you want to connect. That's the only permission step.

2. **AI reads your data through capability-scoped tools.** The AI can call `get_headers`, `get_rows`, and `get_cell` — nothing more. It can't access other Pearls, other data, or the filesystem. The scope is locked to exactly what you granted.

3. **Human-in-the-loop for writes.** When the AI wants to modify your spreadsheet (`set_cell`, `add_row`, `add_column`), Bureau pauses and asks you: *"The agent wants to write changes — Approve or Deny?"* Every write requires your explicit confirmation.

4. **Full audit trail.** Every tool call is logged with the tool name, parameters, result, duration, and which iteration of the AI's reasoning triggered it. You can inspect exactly what the AI did and why.

5. **Persistent connection.** Once granted, the AI Lagoon connection survives Pearl restarts — no need to re-grant via Grapple each time. Disconnect anytime with one click.

### What This Means

| Traditional AI Integration | Bureau + AI Lagoon |
|---|---|
| AI accesses everything in your account | AI sees only the Pearl you connected — nothing else |
| AI writes silently to your documents | Every write requires your approval |
| AI vendor sees your data | AI runs on your server — data never leaves |
| You can't see what the AI did | Full tool call audit trail in the panel |
| Connection is permanent and invisible | You grant and revoke access explicitly via Grapple |

### Technical Details

- **Protocol:** MCP over native Cap'n Proto — no HTTP proxying, no JSON overhead, direct capability passing across Pearl boundaries
- **Architecture:** Bureau acts as an MCP Host, exposing a `ContextProvider` capability. AI Lagoon acts as the `AIAgent`. Bureau passes its ContextProvider into each agent request — the AI calls back to read/write data through the same capability channel
- **Security model:** Object-capability (OCAP). No ambient authority. The AI agent has exactly one capability — the ContextProvider you gave it. It cannot escalate, enumerate other Pearls, or access the network
- **Templates:** Pre-built agent templates (Structured Data Agent, Document Drafter, Process Automation, General Assistant) guide the AI toward common tasks without custom prompting

## What Makes Bureau Different

### 🧱 Every Pearl Is a Sealed Room

A spreadsheet can't see a document. A diagram can't read an image. They're not permission-separated — they're physically isolated containers. A vulnerability in one Pearl cannot reach another. This is Melusina's core architecture, and Bureau inherits it completely.

### 📸 Snapshots Everywhere

Every Pearl type supports named version snapshots. Before a big edit, save a snapshot. Made a mistake last Tuesday? Restore it. Need to compare this quarter's numbers with last quarter's? Browse your history. One click to save. One click to restore.

### 👥 Real-Time Collaboration

See who's connected. See their role. Watch edits appear as they happen. Presence indicators show names and avatars. Connection status tells you when you're online, reconnecting, or offline. When you reconnect, everything syncs automatically.

### 🔐 Four Roles. Server-Enforced.

Not client-side hints — actual server-enforced permission boundaries.

Viewers can't modify data. Period. Not "the button is hidden" — the server rejects the request. Import restrictions are role-gated: CSV import is admin-only, XLSX requires editor.

Need a diagram to reference a spreadsheet? Need an AI to analyze your data? Use Grapple — Melusina's capability system. You pick exactly which two Pearls connect and what capability they exchange. One link. Nothing else changes. Revoke anytime.

### ✈️ Fully Air-Gapped

Every font, every icon, every JavaScript library, every stylesheet — bundled inside the package. Bureau works on a Melusina instance with zero internet access. No CDNs. No external requests. Nothing phones home.

## FAQ

**How is this different from Google Sheets?**
Google Sheets runs on Google's servers. Google can read your data, train AI on it, change terms, raise prices, or get subpoenaed. Bureau runs on your Melusina instance. Your hardware. Your jurisdiction. No one else can see it.

**What about AI — doesn't it send my data to the cloud?**
No. AI Lagoon runs on your Melusina instance alongside Bureau. Your data travels from one Pearl to another on the same machine over a capability channel. Nothing leaves your server. The AI model itself runs locally or connects to a provider you choose and control.

**Can I import my Excel files?**
Yes. XLSX import preserves styles, column widths, and formatting. You can also import CSV and JSON.

**How many people can edit at once?**
Spreadsheet and Document support unlimited simultaneous editors. Diagram and miniPaint use edit locking — one editor at a time, but all connected users see changes live.

**What if I lose connection?**
The status indicator shows your connection state. When you reconnect, the client re-syncs automatically. Document Pearls use CRDT — even concurrent offline edits merge without conflicts.

**Can I leave Melusina and take my data?**
Yes. Export everything in standard formats: XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML. No lock-in. No exit fees.

**Does it need internet after installation?**
No. Every asset is bundled. Bureau works on fully air-gapped Melusina instances.

**Can one Pearl access another Pearl's data?**
Only if you explicitly connect them via Grapple. By default, every Pearl is completely isolated — not permission-separated, physically separated. When you do connect (e.g., Bureau ↔ AI Lagoon), each side exchanges a single capability. The AI can read your spreadsheet headers and rows — it cannot browse your filesystem, access other Pearls, or escalate privileges.
